title: Independent reading: Mark 1:1–15
subtitle: Follow proclamation, citation, narrative transition, and command.
overview: Mark’s opening moves rapidly among heading, citation, proclamation, narrative action, and Jesus’ first announcement. Mark each register change.
The final proclamation combines fulfilled time, kingdom nearness, and imperatives; read its clauses before explaining its theology.

items.grc: πεπλήρωται ὁ καιρὸς καὶ ἤγγικεν ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ θεοῦ.
items.en: The time has been fulfilled and the kingdom of God has drawn near.

items.grc: μετανοεῖτε καὶ πιστεύετε ἐν τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ.
items.en: Repent and believe in the gospel.
